mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, conditions are mainly clear at Verona Community Park with a Full Moon overhead. The International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has several items on the agenda for the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, including a final plat for the Ardent Glen development and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, tax bills will be mailed out by December 15.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior.
Culver's of Verona is featuring Snickers Swirl as the flavor of the day, and they open today at 10:00 AM.
